name: Brandon
personality: Brandon the Bison. Very calm and laid back; straight at first, then playful and teasing once he knows you. Loves superheroes, movies and shows, and is always hyped for the next release. Feature: the town has its own made-up superhero franchise he's obsessed with (e.g. "Captain Carrot 3 comes out Friday!"), with no real Marvel/DC names.

arrival.text: Hey. Brandon. Booth, if you've got one. ...What's your name? [name]. Cool. Thanks.
Hey. Movie later. Thought I'd eat first.
Hey, [name]. You know what this place needs? A sequel. ...I'm kidding. It's great. Okay, now I'm going to tease you forever.
[name]. Oh, you're still working here? Thought you'd been promoted to 'customer.'
Three days until Captain Carrot 3. Three. Days.
Booth, please. My usual. You know the one. Don't pretend you don't.
Your pretzel last time? Ten out of ten. Strong opening. Great cheese.
Last time was a bit burnt. Plot twist. I'll allow it once.

familiar.reply: Extra cheese? Okay, you're officially my favourite chef. Don't let it go to your head.

choices.text: Popcorn's not on the menu, if you were wondering.

familiar.reply: Popcorn would make you a cinema. You're not ready for that responsibility.

order.text: You notice the shirt? Night Moose. First edition design.

choices.reply: (He lights up and explains the whole origin story.) ...Anyway. Pretzel.

choices.text: Is Night Moose the one with the antler cape?

familiar.reply: It's an ANTLER BOOMERANG. Did you even watch the movie? I'm disappointed in you.

choices.text: Nice. What can I get you?
Aren't you a bit old for superheroes?

order.text: Okay, real question. If you were a superhero, what would your power be?

choices.text: Making people's day better, one plate at a time.
choices.reply: ...Okay, that was actually kind of good. I hate it. Pretzel.
Captain Spatula. I'd watch that. Mid-budget. Cult classic.
Hm. Okay. (No more teasing this visit.)

drink.fallback: No Pupsi? Koala-Cola, then. The knock-off. ...They're both knock-offs. Of each other.
favourite: Pupsi. The official drink of movie night.

perfect.familiar: Okay. Standing ovation. I'm not standing. But in my heart.

burnt.text: Burnt. This is the sequel nobody asked for.

eating.text: You know, for a chef, you're pretty good at this. That's a joke. You're great. Mostly.
Rush fell asleep halfway through the Captain Carrot marathon. He says he didn't. He snored through the final battle.
I've seen every Night Moose movie four times. The fourth one is bad. I've seen it six times.
The trailer for Captain Carrot 3 came out. I've watched it twelve times. There's a frame where you can see a carrot in the background. Huge.

eating_chat.text: Captain Carrot 3 comes out this week. Midnight showing. You should come.

choices.text: I'd love to. Save me a seat.

familiar.reply: I'll save you a seat. I'll also judge how loud you eat popcorn.

choices.text: Only if you don't explain every scene to me.

choices.reply: Fair. I'll tell you about it. In detail.

leaving.text: Good stuff, [name]. Two thumbs up. Okay, one and a half.
Movie time. Don't wait up. You weren't going to. I know.

seasons.christmas: Got you a superhero shirt. It's Captain Carrot. Wear it. I'll know if you don't.
seasons.halloween: I'm Night Moose. (He is wearing antlers over his horns. Very serious.)
seasons.new_year: My resolution is to watch less movies. ...Fewer movies. See? I'm already changing.
seasons.summer: Summer blockbuster season. Best time of year.
seasons.winter: It's cold. Perfect excuse to stay in and rewatch everything.
